item.title: Shaw strikes second-half double as Manchester City beat Birmingham 3-1
item.description: Manchester City kicked off their Women's Super League title defence with a 3-1 win over promoted Birmingham City, as last season's top scorer Khadija Shaw struck a second-half double on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Manchester City kicked off their Women's Super League title defence with a 3-1 win over promoted Birmingham City, as last season's top scorer Khadija Shaw struck a second-half double on Sunday. Birmingham's defence, which held out through the first half, finally succumbed to sustained pressure four minutes after the break as Mary Fowler seized on a poor clearance and found the bottom corner. Last season's PFA [USN:L6N44M0ZK TEXT:"women's player of the year, Shaw"], doubled the champions' lead six minutes later, heading Kerstin Casparij's corner into the net. Shaw scored from another corner in the 86th minute, finding the target with a powerful header from Beth Mead's set piece. Oceane Hurtre pulled one back for Birmingham four minutes later.

item.title: Maitland-Niles screamer earns Everton 2-2 draw with Man Utd
item.description: Ainsley Maitland-Niles scored a brilliant equaliser on his debut with virtually the last kick of the game as Everton rescued a point in a 2-2 Premier League draw with Manchester United at the Hill Dickinson Stadium on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ainsley Maitland-Niles scored a brilliant equaliser on his debut with virtually the last kick of the game as Everton rescued a point in a 2-2 Premier League draw with Manchester United at the Hill Dickinson Stadium on Sunday. Benjamin Sesko looked to have won the game for the visitors with an 87th-minute header, but substitute Maitland-Niles hit a first-time shot from 30 yards to preserve his side's unbeaten start to the season. United have four points from their opening three games of the campaign and lie in 11th place in the standings, while Everton are in eighth with five points from the same number of matches. Bryan Mbeumo's superb solo effort had put the visitors in front early in the second half, but Everton grew steadily into the game and Tyrique George equalised with a ferocious shot, before the late goals from Sesko and Maitland-Niles. United will be disappointed not to have taken the three points in a game in which they led twice and struck the bar in the first half through Bruno Fernandes. But Everton had the better of the attacking chances with more shots on target and kept plugging away, showing the kind of fighting spirit they will need this season with their wafer-thin squad following a much-criticised transfer window. Matheus Cunha blazed over from a good position, while the best chance of the first half fell to striker Everton Thierno Barry from Merlin Rohl's superb cross from the right, but he put his free header over the bar. It took United a minute to score in the second period when Mbeumo was able to cut inside from the right and place his left-footed shot from the edge of the box into the far corner. James Tarkowski's excellent last-ditch tackle on Cunha denied the Brazilian a goal, before Everton introduced Jack Grealish in the 66th minute as he began a second loan spell on Merseyside and made a difference to their attacking cohesion. George thundered the ball past United goalkeeper Senne Lammens at the near post to equalise in the 82nd minute, before Sesko looked to have won the game when he headed in Luke Shaw’s cross, until Maitland-Niles came up with his moment of magic at the death.

item.title: Opep+ mantém inalterada política de produção de petróleo para outubro
item.description: A Opep+ manteve inalterada sua política de produção de petróleo para outubro em uma reunião realizada neste domingo, segundo comunicado divulgado pelo grupo.
item.dc:creator: Ahmad Ghaddar, Olesya Astakhova, Alex Lawler
item.content:encoded: A Opep+ manteve inalterada sua política de produção de petróleo para outubro em uma reunião realizada neste domingo, segundo comunicado divulgado pelo grupo. A reunião dos sete membros principais da Opep+ -- Arábia Saudita, Rússia, Iraque, Kuwait, Argélia, Cazaquistão e Omã -- ocorre em um momento em que o conflito envolvendo o Irã continua a interromper as exportações de petróleo pelo Estreito de Ormuz, limitando a influência da entidade sobre os preços e a participação no mercado. Em agosto, a Opep+ concordou com o aumento da produção para setembro, concluindo a reversão gradual do corte de oferta de 1,65 milhão de barris por dia, inicialmente acordado em 2023. Apesar dos aumentos de produção acertados, o grupo formado pela Organização dos Países Exportadores de Petróleo e seus aliados, incluindo a Rússia, ainda produz muito abaixo de suas metas devido à guerra. PODER LIMITADO PELO CONFLITO “Atualmente, a Opep+ tem poder muito limitado sobre o mercado físico de petróleo”, disse Jorge Leon, da Rystad Energy. “O grupo pode alterar as metas de produção no papel, mas não pode garantir que esses barris serão produzidos ou que realmente chegarão ao mercado.” “O foco agora se desloca dos ajustes mensais de produção para o debate muito mais decisivo sobre 2027.” A Opep+ ainda mantém em vigor outra rodada de cortes de produção, abrangendo a maioria dos membros do grupo de 21 países até o fim de 2026. Antes que o grupo decida como reverter os cortes e retornar a produção ao mercado, ele precisa avaliar a capacidade de produção de petróleo dos membros para definir as linhas de base para 2027. Esse debate provavelmente ocorrerá no final de 2026 e, portanto, é provável que a Opep+ suspenda seus aumentos de produção no quarto trimestre, segundo informaram anteriormente fontes à Reuters. O comunicado divulgado neste domingo não fez menção à política para além de outubro.

item.title: Mulher é encontrada viva no Nepal dias após família iniciar rituais fúnebres
item.description: Acreditando que ela tivesse morrido nas enchentes mortais do Nepal, a família de Chandika Kumari Shrestha iniciou o ritual de luto pela morte da idosa.
item.dc:creator: Adnan Abidi
item.content:encoded: Acreditando que ela tivesse morrido nas enchentes mortais do Nepal, a família de Chandika Kumari Shrestha iniciou o ritual de luto pela morte da idosa. Dez dias depois, equipes de resgate a encontraram viva dentro de sua casa desmoronada na devastada vila de Betrawati. Kumari havia sobrevivido em uma pequena bolsa de ar em meio à água e à lama. “A casa de quatro andares foi levada pelas enchentes e ficou no meio de areia movediça. Enquanto caminhávamos ao redor dela, ouvimos uma voz dizendo ‘salve-me’”, disse o policial Mahendra Darnal. Em uma operação de resgate no sábado, que durou 45 minutos, Darnal e sua equipe encontraram Shrestha em um espaço confinado e a levaram para um hospital do exército. “Eu estava em contato com a família e eles já haviam iniciado o período de luto de 11 dias”, disse Darnal. Shrestha estava entre as centenas de desaparecidos em Betrawati, uma das áreas mais atingidas pelas enchentes no Nepal e coberta por depósitos brancos compactados quase como concreto. Equipes continuavam atuando para recuperar dezenas de corpos. O mercado da cidade e a maioria dos prédios residenciais, alguns com até quatro andares, ficaram quase totalmente soterrados sob os escombros deixados por uma torrente que varreu o vale, parte de um desastre que matou mais de 1.300 pessoas em todo o Nepal. Milhares continuam desaparecidos. Equipes de resgate usando capacetes foram vistas cavando com pás, enquanto outras rastejavam pelas frestas dos prédios desabados, apitando periodicamente para chamar a atenção de quem estivesse preso e vivo. Cinco dias antes, 24 corpos foram encontrados em estado de decomposição na área do mercado de Betrawati, em um prédio que abrigava uma pequena loja, disse Darnal. EM BUSCA DE SINAIS DE VIDA Onze dias depois que o desabamento glacial provocou as inundações devastadoras, cerca de 5.000 pessoas continuam desaparecidas. Centenas de corpos foram levados pelas águas até as margens de rios distantes do devastado distrito de Rasuwa. Em Chitwan, a centenas de milhas de distância, ocorreram várias rodadas de enterros em massa para corpos não identificados e em avançado estado de decomposição. Mesmo com a esperança começando a se esvaecer, as autoridades do Nepal continuam seus esforços para procurar pessoas presas em túneis e sob as espessas camadas de lama que endureceram sobre os prédios. Desde sexta-feira, elas resgataram três pessoas dos túneis, incluindo um cidadão chinês próximo ao rio Trishuli, onde acredita-se que mais de 900 pessoas estejam presas. Outros, como Shrestha, sobreviveram em condições extraordinárias, incluindo um menino de 8 anos.

item.title: Brazilian court suspends licenses for Sigma Lithium mine
item.description: A Brazilian judge ordered the suspension of environmental licenses and mining activities at Sigma Lithium's Grota do Cirilo mine, a court document seen by Reuters showed.
item.dc:creator: Fabio Teixeira
item.content:encoded: A Brazilian judge ordered the suspension of environmental licenses and mining activities at Sigma Lithium's (SGML.V) Grota do Cirilo mine, a court document seen by Reuters showed. The decision was made on Friday in a civil suit brought by the Federation of Quilombola Communities of Minas Gerais, where the group said the miner's project was within the direct area of influence of the Bau Quilombola Community. Quilombolas are traditional communities of African descent, which were created by people who escaped slavery. Their territories are protected by the state, with more extensive licensing for projects that could impact them. Judge Antonio Lucio Tulio de Oliveira Barbosa said there was sufficient evidence that the Bau territory fell within the project's area of influence, triggering obligations for procedures including a free, prior and informed consultation with the community. The judge said there was risk of harm to the community, as Sigma's mining complex carried out "constant blasting and earthmoving activities just a few kilometres from the traditional territory." The judge cited studies indicating the territory is about 2.7 km (1.7 miles) from the project's directly affected area, well within the 8 km threshold that triggers the more extensive process. Sigma has argued the project lies outside the impact zone. The court ordered an independent georeferencing expert review to determine the exact distance between the project and the Quilombola territory. Beyond suspending environmental licenses the decision bars Minas Gerais state from granting new ones, and establishes a fine for Sigma if it continues its operations. The mine, Sigma's only productive asset, has a nameplate capacity of 330,000 tons of lithium oxide concentrate on an annualised basis. Sigma did not reply to a request for comment made outside normal working hours.

item.title: Alemanha planeja escudo antissabotagem após ataque com drone em aeroporto
item.description: A Alemanha está planejando um amplo pacote de medidas para reforçar suas defesas contra ataques com drones, invasões cibernéticas e outras formas de sabotagem russa, após um ataque fracassado com drones a um aeroporto no mês passado, afirmou neste domingo um porta-voz do Ministério do Interior.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Alemanha está planejando um amplo pacote de medidas para reforçar suas defesas contra ataques com drones, invasões cibernéticas e outras formas de sabotagem russa, após um ataque fracassado com drones a um aeroporto no mês passado, afirmou neste domingo um porta-voz do Ministério do Interior. Em entrevista ao jornal “Bild am Sonntag”, que foi o primeiro a noticiar os planos, o ministro do Interior, Alexander Dobrindt, disse que os ataques híbridos da Rússia se tornaram parte da realidade cotidiana. “Esses ataques vão aumentar, mas podemos nos defender e nos proteger”, disse Dobrindt, segundo a reportagem. A Rússia há muito rejeita as alegações de que estaria realizando operações na Europa Ocidental e negou envolvimento no ataque ao aeroporto alemão. O ministro das Relações Exteriores da Rússia, Sergei Lavrov, afirmou que as acusações eram “o início de uma guerra real”, segundo a agência de notícias estatal TASS. De acordo com o porta-voz do ministério, os recursos móveis da polícia para defesa contra drones seriam ampliados no âmbito do plano. Unidades de combate a drones de rápida mobilização seriam estacionadas nas cidades para proteger o espaço aéreo acima de centros de transporte críticos e distritos governamentais. Além disso, empresas que operam infraestruturas críticas, como concessionárias de energia e fabricantes do setor de defesa, receberiam autorização legal não apenas para detectar drones, mas também para repeli-los ativamente. Seria estabelecido um escudo de proteção nacional, ou “cyberdome”, envolvendo uma rede de sensores digitais projetados para detectar e interceptar tentativas de ataques cibernéticos. O governo também pretende ampliar o uso de tecnologias apoiadas por IA, reconhecimento facial biométrico e vigilância por vídeo -- por exemplo, em estações ferroviárias -- para identificar suspeitos que estejam preparando atos de sabotagem.

item.title: Irã diz que lidará com questões econômicas e ameaça novos ataques “mais dolorosos”
item.description: O Irã afirmou que intensificará os esforços para lidar com os problemas causados pelas sanções dos Estados Unidos, que estão prejudicando gravemente sua economia, enquanto uma alta autoridade iraniana alertou sobre uma “resposta dolorosa” caso o país venha a sofrer novos ataques.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Irã afirmou que intensificará os esforços para lidar com os problemas causados pelas sanções dos Estados Unidos, que estão prejudicando gravemente sua economia, enquanto uma alta autoridade iraniana alertou sobre uma “resposta dolorosa” caso o país venha a sofrer novos ataques. Seis meses após os primeiros ataques dos EUA e de Israel contra o Irã, a guerra parece estar em um impasse. Um acordo preliminar de cessar-fogo firmado em junho desmoronou e pouco progresso foi alcançado nos esforços diplomáticos para retomar o processo de paz. Após uma pausa nas ações militares durante grande parte de agosto, os ataques de retaliação foram retomados, com o Comando Central dos EUA informando que atingiu três petroleiros iranianos no sábado, em resposta ao lançamento de mísseis balísticos pela Guarda Revolucionária Islâmica contra dois navios da Marinha norte-americana. Na esteira dos ataques, o presidente do Parlamento iraniano, Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, disse neste domingo que os EUA deveriam compreender, “antes que seja tarde demais", que as regras do jogo na guerra contra o Irã mudaram. “A partir de agora, qualquer ataque contra os interesses e a segurança do Irã receberá uma resposta mais rápida, mais contundente e mais dolorosa”, disse ele em um discurso publicado em seu canal no Telegram. Teerã demonstrou que ainda mantém a capacidade de atacar os interesses dos EUA em países vizinhos e de interromper o fluxo de petróleo pelo Estreito de Ormuz, por onde passava um quinto do abastecimento global de petróleo antes do conflito. SANÇÕES E BLOQUEIO PRESSIONAM ECONOMIA No entanto, a campanha dos EUA para sufocar a economia do Irã está se tornando cada vez mais difícil de suportar, segundo três fontes iranianas de alto escalão. Em seu discurso neste domingo, Qalibaf acrescentou que, além da frente militar, a principal batalha do Irã agora era em torno da produção e dos meios de subsistência da população. Ele citou as fortes flutuações cambiais, a inflação, o desemprego e a gestão do mercado como os principais desafios, acrescentando que os iranianos poderiam tolerar as dificuldades, mas não a má gestão ou a inércia. Segundo ele, os iranianos esperam que o governo aja rapidamente. O ministro da Economia do Irã, Ali Madanizadeh, disse que Teerã planeja responder à pressão econômica dos EUA com reformas. Ele rejeitou a ideia de que as sanções levariam o país a mudar de rumo, informou a mídia estatal neste domingo. “Eles falam de pressão econômica e isolamento, de romper laços financeiros, e acham que, ao pressionar a economia de um país, podem mudar as decisões de seu povo”, disse Madanizadeh. “Tenho que esclarecer um ponto: a responsabilidade pela reforma da economia do Irã cabe ao seu governo e ao seu povo, não ao Tesouro dos EUA.” Ao mesmo tempo, o vice-ministro da Economia, Morteza Zamanian, afirmou neste domingo que a “Central de Guerra Econômica” do ministério estava redobrando seus esforços para resolver os problemas causados pela guerra, segundo a agência de notícias semioficial Tasnim. ILHA DE KHARG FOI ATINGIDA 550 VEZES, DIZ IRÃ O Irã é o terceiro maior produtor da Organização dos Países Exportadores de Petróleo e exportava 90% de seu petróleo bruto por meio do centro de exportação da Ilha de Kharg antes da guerra. Os fluxos foram interrompidos desde que o bloqueio dos EUA às exportações de petróleo iraniano começou, em meados de abril. Em 31 de agosto, Trump publicou postagem de uma linha nas redes sociais acompanhada de um vídeo gerado por IA mostrando a Ilha de Kharg sendo “reduzida a pedacinhos”. As autoridades iranianas prometeram uma resposta contundente caso Kharg seja atacada. Em uma entrevista transmitida pela TV estatal neste domingo, o ministro do Petróleo do Irã, Mohsen Paknejad, disse que a ilha havia sido atingida cerca de 550 vezes nos meses anteriores, mas continuava em operação. O Irã também impôs um bloqueio ao Estreito de Ormuz, criando um problema para o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, ao elevar os preços dos combustíveis globalmente antes das eleições de meio de mandato, em novembro. No sábado, o Comando Central dos EUA informou ter atacado três embarcações iranianas, incluindo uma na costa da Ilha de Kharg, depois que a Guarda Revolucionária Islâmica do Irã (IRGC) lançou mísseis balísticos contra dois navios da Marinha norte-americana. “Que a mensagem para a IRGC fique clara: se vocês atirarem em dois de nossos navios, imporemos um custo econômico ainda maior -- destruindo três dos seus”, disse o almirante Brad Cooper, chefe do Comando Central dos EUA, que supervisiona as forças armadas no Oriente Médio. O IRGC respondeu ameaçando intensificar os ataques contra navios militares dos EUA na região e afirmou posteriormente ter atacado os três petroleiros, bem como três embarcações ligadas aos EUA em outras áreas. “Não se deixem enganar pelas forças armadas ‘terroristas’ dos EUA e evitem qualquer movimento suspeito com o objetivo de passar por vias navegáveis não autorizadas”, afirmou a Marinha do IRGC em comunicado transmitido pela TV estatal iraniana. “Caso contrário, vocês serão alvos.” A Tasnim, agência de notícias semioficial iraniana, informou que quatro mísseis norte-americanos atingiram um petroleiro na área do ancoradouro de Kharg. A Tasnim citou fontes locais afirmando que não houve vítimas e que a tripulação do petroleiro estava sendo evacuada. Nenhum militar norte-americano ficou ferido, informou o Comando Central. Neste domingo, a Tasnim informou que o IRGC havia abatido um balão de vigilância dos EUA sobre Erbil, no norte do Iraque, descrevendo a ação como parte de um esforço mais amplo para eliminar os sistemas de vigilância aérea e de alerta antecipado dos EUA na região.

item.title: Acidente com ônibus deixa pelo menos 25 mortos em Cabo Verde, diz agência
item.description: Pelo menos 25 pessoas, muitas delas crianças em idade escolar e adolescentes, morreram após um ônibus cair em uma ravina no Fogo, uma das ilhas de Cabo Verde no Oceano Atlântico, na costa da África Ocidental, informou neste domingo a agência nacional de notícias Inforpress.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Pelo menos 25 pessoas, muitas delas crianças em idade escolar e adolescentes, morreram após um ônibus cair em uma ravina no Fogo, uma das ilhas de Cabo Verde no Oceano Atlântico, na costa da África Ocidental, informou neste domingo a agência nacional de notícias Inforpress. O acidente ocorreu em uma estrada de montanha no norte do Fogo na noite de sábado, quando o ônibus saiu da pista e despencou cerca de 30 metros em uma ravina íngreme, informou a agência. Muitos dos passageiros eram alunos do ensino fundamental e médio, acrescentou a agência. Vários passageiros feridos foram levados ao Hospital Regional San Francisco de Assis, no Fogo. Autoridades da área de educação afirmaram que o passeio não foi organizado pelas escolas locais, mas sim de forma particular pelo motorista, que estava entre as vítimas fatais, informou a Inforpress.

item.title: Infantino vai concorrer à reeleição na Fifa em março, diz entidade
item.description: O presidente da Fifa, Gianni Infantino, continua decidido a concorrer à reeleição, afirmou neste domingo um porta-voz do órgão mundial do futebol, apesar da renovada oposição à sua candidatura após um plano malsucedido de vender uma participação nas competições da entidade a investidores privados.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente da Fifa, Gianni Infantino, continua decidido a concorrer à reeleição, afirmou neste domingo um porta-voz do órgão mundial do futebol, apesar da renovada oposição à sua candidatura após um plano malsucedido de vender uma participação nas competições da entidade a investidores privados. Infantino, que já havia anunciado que buscaria um quarto mandato em março de 2027, tem enfrentado pedidos de renúncia por parte da Uefa, da AFC e da Concacaf, depois que seu plano de vender uma participação de 20% na Copa do Mundo e em outros eventos da Fifa foi descartado em função de reação negativa generalizada em julho. Mas o presidente de 56 anos mantém o apoio das confederações africana e sul-americana. “O presidente da Fifa anunciou em abril que concorrerá à reeleição em 2027. É claro que nada mudou. O Sr. Infantino concorrerá à reeleição”, afirmou um porta-voz da Fifa em comunicado. O comunicado foi divulgado depois que Infantino se manteve calado quando questionado se arrepende das turbulentas últimas seis semanas, enquanto assistia à Copa do Mundo Sub-20 na Polônia, no sábado. “Haverá muito a dizer, mas haverá o lugar e o momento certos para dizer isso”, disse Infantino. Ninguém anunciou formalmente uma candidatura para desafiar Infantino na eleição do próximo ano.

item.title: China injetará US$54 bilhões em bancos estatais e seguradoras para reforçar capital
item.description: O Ministério das Finanças da China vai liderar injeções de capital no valor total de US$54 bilhões em seguradoras e bancos estatais, informaram as empresas neste domingo, em uma iniciativa coordenada por Pequim para reforçar o capital em todo o sistema financeiro.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Ministério das Finanças da China vai liderar injeções de capital no valor total de US$54 bilhões em seguradoras e bancos estatais, informaram as empresas neste domingo, em uma iniciativa coordenada por Pequim para reforçar o capital em todo o sistema financeiro. A China Life Insurance (Group) Co, a maior seguradora de vida do país, receberá 35 bilhões de iuanes (US$5,2 bilhões), enquanto o China Taiping Insurance Group receberá 7 bilhões de iuanes, informaram os dois grupos em comunicados. Separadamente, a People’s Insurance Company (Group) of China (601319.SS) informou que planeja levantar até 15 bilhões de iuanes por meio de uma emissão privada de ações da série A junto ao Ministério das Finanças, com os recursos a serem utilizados para reabastecer seu capital. A iniciativa pode ajudar a fortalecer as seguradoras estatais, que receberam orientação para apoiar o mercado de ações com recursos de médio e longo prazo, ao mesmo tempo em que as posicionaria para auxiliar os órgãos reguladores na gestão de seguradoras menores e de maior risco. ESTABILIDADE DO SETOR FINANCEIRO O setor de seguros vem enfrentando uma erosão na lucratividade devido às taxas de juros persistentemente baixas, com inúmeras seguradoras de pequeno e médio porte relatando a deterioração de seus índices de solvência. A China Export and Credit Insurance Corp também informou que o Ministério das Finanças injetará 10 bilhões de iuanes para reforçar seu capital principal, e a China Reinsurance (Group) anunciou que levantará 3 bilhões de iuanes. “A injeção é um passo importante do país para aumentar a capacidade do setor financeiro de atender à economia real e promover o desenvolvimento de alta qualidade dos setores financeiro e de seguros”, afirmou a China Life em comunicado, acrescentando que isso fortaleceria a capacidade do grupo de resistir a riscos. A Taiping afirmou que os recursos reforçariam sua solvência e outros indicadores-chave. PLANO DE RECAPITALIZAÇÃO Separadamente, três bancos estatais também anunciaram neste domingo que receberão, no total, 290 bilhões de iuanes em injeções de capital. O plano foi divulgado pela primeira vez em uma reunião parlamentar anual em março deste ano, ampliando uma ferramenta de financiamento que havia ajudado a fortalecer alguns outros grandes bancos estatais no ano passado. O Banco Agrícola da China (601288.SS) e o Banco Industrial e Comercial da China (601398.SS) , dois dos maiores bancos estatais do país, afirmaram que planejam levantar até 160 bilhões de iuanes e 100 bilhões de iuanes, respectivamente, por meio de colocações privadas de ações da classe A junto ao Ministério das Finanças, à China National Tobacco Corp e suas subsidiárias. Ambos os bancos afirmaram que os recursos arrecadados seriam utilizados integralmente para reabastecer o capital Tier 1 básico, em uma medida para ajudar a sustentar a expansão do crédito, à medida que Pequim pressiona os bancos estatais a apoiar o crescimento. A fraca demanda por empréstimos continua sendo um obstáculo persistente para a segunda maior economia do mundo, o que também vem prejudicando a lucratividade do setor bancário. O Banco de Exportação e Importação da China, uma das três instituições financeiras de política pública do país, informou que o Ministério das Finanças injetará 30 bilhões de iuanes no banco, reforçando efetivamente sua base de capital.

item.title: Antonelli takes sensational home Italian GP win from back of grid
item.description: Formula One leader Kimi Antonelli won his home Italian Grand Prix after racing from 19th to first on Sunday in a massive blow for Mercedes teammate and closest championship rival George Russell.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Formula One leader Kimi Antonelli won his home Italian Grand Prix after racing from 19th to first on Sunday in a massive blow for Mercedes teammate and closest championship rival George Russell. The 20-year-old was the first Italian winner at Monza since Ludovico Scarfiotti for Ferrari in 1966. Russell, who had led a re-start after Ferrari's Charles Leclerc crashed heavily at the end of lap two, finished second after being hunted down by his teammate with Max Verstappen third for Red Bull. The Briton had hoped to slash Antonelli's 59-point lead after the Italian took an engine penalty and started on the back row of the grid but instead ended up 66 adrift after 13 rounds.

item.title: Israel's Netanyahu orders West Bank settler outposts to be removed, sources say
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has ordered unauthorized settler outposts in the West Bank to be dismantled, two people familiar with the matter said on Sunday, amid pressure from the U.S. to crack down on settler attacks on Palestinians.
item.dc:creator: Alexander Cornwell
item.content:encoded: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has ordered unauthorized settler outposts in the West Bank to be dismantled, two people familiar with the matter said on Sunday, amid [USN:L8N44H0H7 TEXT:"pressure"] from the U.S. to crack down on settler attacks on Palestinians. The order applies to outposts established by settlers without official authorisation from the Israeli state, the sources said. Outposts typically consist of prefabricated caravans and house a small number of settlers. The state has from time to time demolished such structures and also formally recognized others, allowing them to access government funding. It was not immediately clear when the operation would begin. U.N. bodies and most governments deem all Israeli settlements illegal under international law and consider the West Bank to be occupied territory under military control. Israel argues the territory is disputed, not occupied. U.S. URGES ISRAEL TO ACT AGAINST SETTLER VIOLENCE Netanyahu had ordered the eviction of the unauthorized outposts in response to pressure from the United States, the country's closest ally, the sources said. U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee on Saturday [USN:L1N44X01W TEXT:"denounced"] violent settlers as terrorists and called for them to face severe consequences following a meeting with several Palestinian Americans in a West Bank Palestinian town. Israeli website Ynet earlier reported the orders targeted around 100 outposts across the occupied territory. The Israeli prime minister's office and the military, who would normally take part in clearing any outposts in the West Bank, did not immediately respond to a request to comment. Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich, asked at a conference in Jerusalem about the Ynet report, said Netanyahu has given "an instruction to evict places built in Areas A and B", referring to parts of the West Bank in which most Palestinians live. Under the Oslo Accords, interim peace agreements reached in the 1990s between Israel and the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO), the West Bank was split into three zones: A, B and C. Smotrich, a settler himself who has overseen settlement housing projects and formally recognised homes built illegally, said while he disagreed with Netanyahu's decision, the government had made huge strides in advancing settlements in Area C. HUNDREDS OF OUTPOSTS ACROSS THE WEST BANK There are 340 outposts in the West Bank along with 146 settlements formally recognised by the Israeli government, according to Peace Now, an Israeli organisation that is critical of settlement expansion and advocates for a two-state solution. Last month, Israeli settlers [USN:L8N44B0ZG TEXT:"besieged"] the homes of Palestinians in a nearby village, including one owned by a Palestinian American, before the military [USN:L1N44A0G5 TEXT:"forced them"] from the area. The village's Palestinian residents have said they have continued to face harassment and intimidation by Israeli settlers. The Israeli government has condemned settler violence, though perpetrators are rarely arrested and even less frequently prosecuted. On Saturday, U.S. ambassador Huckabee said it was in Israel's own interest to take action against settlers carrying out what he described as "criminal behaviour and terrorism".

item.title: Israeli strike kills two people in Gaza, medics say
item.description: An Israeli strike killed at least two Palestinians, including a child, in the Gaza Strip on Sunday, health officials said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: An Israeli strike killed at least two Palestinians, including a child, in the Gaza Strip on Sunday, health officials said. Mohamed Abu Selmia, head of the enclave's largest Al Shifa Hospital, said the Israeli airstrike struck a vehicle in western Gaza City killing two people, including a girl, and wounding six others. The Israeli military did not immediately comment on the incident. An October 2025 U.S.-backed [USN:L6N44W0HN TEXT:"ceasefire"] halted major fighting in the territory, but it failed to end strikes by the Israeli military, which it said aimed to thwart attacks by Hamas and other Gaza militants. Hamas accuses Israel of violating the ceasefire and undermining efforts to implement U.S. President Donald Trump's broader plan to end the Gaza conflict, which also includes Israeli withdrawals and Hamas disarmament. More than 1,300 Palestinians, mostly civilians, have been killed in Gaza since the ceasefire took effect last October, according to the territory's health officials, while the Israeli military says four Israeli soldiers have been killed. Hamas does not usually disclose information about fatalities among its fighters.

item.title: Son of EssilorLuxottica founder calls for new strategy for eyewear group
item.description: Franco-Italian eyewear group EssilorLuxottica needs a new strategy after losing more than half of its stock market value in recent months, the son of its late founder said on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Franco-Italian eyewear group EssilorLuxottica (ESLX.PA) needs a new strategy after losing more than half of its stock market value in recent months, the son of its late founder said on Sunday. Leonardo Maria Del Vecchio last month [USN:L8N44M08E TEXT:"stepped down"] from management roles at the group, whose brands include Ray-Ban, Oakley and Vogue Eyewear, after reported tensions with CEO Francesco Milleri, but remains an investor in the group through family holding company Delfin. Speaking on the sidelines of the annual TEHA Ambrosetti conference on the shores of Lake Como, Del Vecchio said he was hoping for "a new chapter" for the group. Delfin has a 32.4% stake in EssilorLuxottica and also owns stakes in several financial groups in Italy, including 17.5% of Monte dei Paschi (BMPS.MI) , which is the target of a [USN:L4N42G0DE TEXT:"takeover bid"] by Intesa Sanpaolo (ISP.MI) . Del Vecchio said there was too much focus on his relations with Milleri, who also chairs Delfin, and the current consolidation wave in the Italian banking sector. "Banks are a financial investment. The industrial investment that must be protected is EssilorLuxottica," Del Vecchio said. "EssilorLuxottica is Delfin's legacy, our father's true investment and enduring legacy, yet it has lost 50% of its market value." Del Vecchio also said that no one had yet asked Delfin's investors what to do with the stake in Monte dei Paschi and criticised the board of the holding company for alleged opaqueness.

item.title: Népal Une vieille dame retrouvée vivante dans sa maison détruite
item.description: Persuadée qu'elle avait trouvé la mort dans les inondations meurtrières du Népal, la famille de Chandika Kumari Shrestha avait entamé les rituels du deuil à sa mémoire.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Persuadée qu'elle avait trouvé la mort dans les inondations meurtrières du Népal, la famille de Chandika Kumari Shrestha avait entamé les rituels du deuil à sa mémoire. Dix jours plus tard, les sauveteurs ont retrouvée la vieille dame vivante à l'intérieur de sa maison effondrée dans le village de Betrawati, où elle a survécu dans l'eau et la boue grâce à une étroite poche d'air. "La maison de quatre étages a été emportée par les inondations. En faisant un état des lieux, nous avons entendu une voix crier 'Au secours !' ", a raconté un officier de police, Mahendra Darnal. "J'étais en contact avec la famille et ils avaient entamé la période de deuil de 11 jours". Dégagée samedi lors d'une opération de 45 minutes, la victime a été envoyée dans un hôpital militaire. Des centaines de personnes sont portées disparues à Betrawati, une région du Népal parmi les plus durement touchées par les inondations, aujourd'hui recouverte d'une couche de boue blanche compacte dure comme du béton. Les équipes de secours continuent de récupérer de nombreux corps. Le marché de la ville et la plupart des immeubles d'habitation ont été ensevelis sous les débris charriés par le torrent qui a dévalé la vallée. La catastrophe due à l'effondrement d'un glacier a fait plus de 1.300 morts, et quelque 5.000 personnes sont toujours portées disparues. Depuis vendredi, trois personnes ont été secourues, dont un ressortissant chinois, dans les tunnels où plus de 900 personnes ont été prises au piège. D'autres, comme Chandika Kumari Shrestha, ont survécu dans des conditions extrêmes, notamment un garçon de huit ans qui a pu retrouver sa mère.

item.title: Los ataques israelíes causan cuatro muertos en el sur del Líbano
item.description: Los ataques israelíes causaron la muerte de cuatro personas, entre ellas dos mujeres, en el sur del Líbano el domingo, según informó el Ministerio de Sanidad libanés, en lo que constituyó una represalia de Israel por lo que, según afirmó, fueron ataques con drones de Hezbolá en zonas ocupadas por sus tropas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los ataques israelíes causaron la muerte de cuatro personas, entre ellas dos mujeres, en el sur del Líbano el domingo, según informó el Ministerio de Sanidad libanés, en lo que constituyó una represalia de Israel por lo que, según afirmó, fueron ataques con drones de Hezbolá en zonas ocupadas por sus tropas. A pesar del alto el fuego con Hezbolá acordado en junio y negociado por Estados Unidos, el ejército israelí sigue operando en lo que ha declarado como zona de seguridad en el sur del Líbano. El Ministerio de Sanidad libanés indicó que dos hombres murieron en una localidad situada en el límite de la zona ocupada por las tropas israelíes, mientras que las dos mujeres fallecieron en Arab Salim, que se encuentra bastante al norte de la zona ocupada. El ejército israelí había emitido una advertencia de evacuación en línea a las 6:00 de la mañana, hora local (0300 GMT), para las zonas cercanas a un edificio en Arab Salim que, según afirmó, iba a atacar porque estaba siendo utilizado por Hezbolá. Dos niñas se encontraban entre las otras seis personas heridas en ese ataque. La oficina del presidente libanés, Joseph Aoun, calificó los ataques del domingo —que, según afirmó, destruyeron un hospital y causaron daños en un edificio del Ministerio de Hacienda— de «una peligrosa escalada» dirigida contra "administraciones y centros sanitarios puramente civiles". "El presidente Aoun responsabilizó plenamente a la parte israelí de esta escalada en curso y pidió a Estados Unidos y a la comunidad internacional que tomaran medidas inmediatas para detener estas violaciones y exigir responsabilidades a los autores", afirmó. El ejército israelí afirmó que entre sus objetivos se encontraban lo que describió como instalaciones de almacenamiento de armas de Hezbolá y un centro de mando situado en el interior de un edificio que anteriormente se utilizaba como hospital. También señaló que utilizó munición de precisión y vigilancia aérea para minimizar los daños a la población civil. La orden de evacuación del domingo fue solo la segunda emitida desde el anuncio del alto el fuego en junio.

item.title: En frontera China y Nepal, devastada por inundaciones, no queda rastro de un puerto: testigos Reuters
item.description: Unos 20 rescatistas chinos, vestidos de naranja brillante, utilizaron el domingo excavadoras, palas y detectores de radar en un intento por localizar a los cientos de personas desaparecidas desde que un deslizamiento de tierra, similar a un tsunami, arrasó el principal paso fronterizo de China con Nepal.
item.dc:creator: Nicoco Chan, Tingshu Wang
item.content:encoded: Unos 20 rescatistas chinos, vestidos de naranja brillante, utilizaron el domingo excavadoras, palas y detectores de radar en un intento por localizar a los cientos de personas desaparecidas desde que un deslizamiento de tierra, similar a un tsunami, arrasó el principal paso fronterizo de China con Nepal. El paso fronterizo de Gyirong, que separa el Tíbet chino de Nepal, se convirtió en un espeluznante símbolo de la devastación que siguió al derrumbe de un glaciar en el lado nepalí de la frontera el 26 de agosto. Reuters y otras agencias de noticias visitaron el domingo el paso fronterizo terrestre, situado en un estrecho desfiladero fluvial, en un viaje organizado por el Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de China. No quedaba rastro alguno del edificio de aduanas chino de cinco plantas que se alzaba en la frontera antes de la catástrofe, según mostraban los vídeos y las imágenes tomadas en el lugar. La única estructura aún visible de antes del alud de lodo era una parte de una torre de agua cercana. Los trabajadores habían colocado una bandera china en el lugar donde antes se encontraba la puerta fronteriza, de casi 20 metros de altura. Detrás de las señales de peligro en las que se leía «Zona de peligro, pasar rápidamente», tres grupos de unos 20 trabajadores de rescate y recuperación excavaban la tierra con palas, mientras varias excavadoras permanecían a la espera el domingo por la tarde.

item.title: Dodgers turn to Justin Wrobleski in series finale vs. Nationals
item.description: After dealing with a number of lineup changes of late, the Los Angeles Dodgers will make an adjustment to their starting rotation in the series finale against the visiting Washington Nationals on Sunday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: After dealing with a number of lineup changes of late, the Los Angeles Dodgers will make an adjustment to their starting rotation in the series finale against the visiting Washington Nationals on Sunday night. Justin Wrobleski, who was a National League All-Star this season, will make the start in his return to the rotation. Los Angeles (85-57) has played the last three games without Shohei Ohtani, who is dealing with right biceps, neck and left knee injuries. Dalton Rushing was expected to replace Ohtani at designated hitter on Saturday, but he was a late scratch with elbow discomfort. Veteran Freddie Freeman received a day of rest Friday, while catcher Will Smith was used off the bench Saturday. Max Muncy was also a late scratch Saturday with an illness. Tommy Edman, Teoscar Hernandez and Mookie Betts are due for days off soon as well. Edman proved to be the hero Saturday with a go-ahead three-run home run in the seventh inning of a 6-5 victory over the Nationals. Hernandez had an RBI single from the DH spot. Ohtani took swings in an indoor batting cage Saturday for the first time in three days. If he goes on the IL on Sunday it will be for a minimum of 15 days, which is required of pitchers and designated two-way players. "I think the main thing with (keeping Ohtani on the active roster) is his health," Roberts said. "That's the most important thing. And then we can find ways to log at-bats to get him up to speed. So I think that's kind of where all of our heads are at." Wrobleski (11-5, 3.65 ERA) was bumped from the rotation last month when Blake Snell and Tyler Glasnow returned from the injured list. He went on the injured list on August 16 with forearm discomfort. He entered Tuesday's game in the seventh inning vs. St. Louis and allowed three runs (two earned) in two innings of a 13-8 loss. Wrobleski was blitzed for eight runs on eight hits in five innings of his lone start last season against the Nationals. James Wood had a single and a run scored for the Nationals in Saturday's defeat, the third consecutive for the club. Wood has a hit in all three games since his return from a month away because of a left oblique strain. "When you have an extended period of time like he had injured, you worry about the timing," Nationals manager Blake Butera said, according to MLB.com. "But he's done a nice job, especially as he's gotten more at-bats since he's been back, looking comfortable all the time." Wood has five home runs, with 12 RBIs and 10 runs scored in 11 career games against the Dodgers. Keibert Ruiz returned for Washington on Saturday and had two hits with an RBI after last playing Wednesday when he was hit by a foul ball in his catcher's mask. Ruiz is a former Dodgers' prospect who was traded to the Nationals in 2021. Washington (67-77) is set to send left-hander Andrew Alvarez (2-6, 3.47) to the mound. Alvarez, a native of nearby Los Alamitos, is coming off his best start of the season when he went six scoreless innings last Sunday against the Miami Marlins. It will be Alvarez's first career start at Dodger Stadium, which is less than 30 miles north of his hometown. -Field Level Media

item.title: Alemania planea un escudo antisabotaje tras el ataque con un dron en el aeropuerto
item.description: Alemania está preparando un amplio paquete de medidas para reforzar sus defensas frente a ataques con drones, intrusiones cibernéticas y otras formas de sabotaje ruso tras el fallido ataque con drones perpetrado el mes pasado en un aeropuerto, declaró el domingo un portavoz del Ministerio del Interior.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Alemania está preparando un amplio paquete de medidas para reforzar sus defensas frente a ataques con drones, intrusiones cibernéticas y otras formas de sabotaje ruso tras el fallido ataque con drones perpetrado el mes pasado en un aeropuerto, declaró el domingo un portavoz del Ministerio del Interior. El ministro del Interior, Alexander Dobrindt, declaró al periódico "Bild am Sonntag" —que fue el primero en informar sobre estos planes— que los ataques híbridos de Rusia se habían convertido en parte de la realidad cotidiana. "Estos ataques aumentarán, pero podemos defendernos y protegernos", afirmó Dobrindt según se cita en el artículo. Rusia lleva mucho tiempo rechazando las acusaciones de que está llevando a cabo operaciones en Europa Occidental y ha negado su implicación en el ataque al aeropuerto alemán; el ministro de Asuntos Exteriores, Serguéi Lavrov, afirmó que las acusaciones eran "el comienzo de una guerra real", según la agencia estatal de noticias TASS. Según el portavoz del ministerio, el plan prevé ampliar las capacidades móviles de la policía para la defensa contra drones, con unidades antidrones de despliegue rápido estacionadas en las ciudades para proteger el espacio aéreo sobre los nudos de transporte críticos y los barrios gubernamentales. A las empresas que gestionan infraestructuras críticas, como las compañías eléctricas y los fabricantes del sector de la defensa, se les concedería la autoridad legal no solo para detectar drones, sino también para repelerlos de forma activa. Se crearía un escudo protector nacional, o "cibercúpula", que incluiría una red de sensores digitales diseñados para detectar e interceptar intentos de ataques informáticos. El Gobierno también tiene la intención de ampliar el uso de tecnologías basadas en la inteligencia artificial, el reconocimiento facial biométrico y la videovigilancia —por ejemplo, en las estaciones de tren— para identificar a presuntos atacantes que preparen actos de sabotaje.

item.title: South Korea's Lee Chang-dong tackles labour trauma in Venice comeback
item.description: South Korean director Lee Chang-dong returned to the big screen on Sunday after an eight-year hiatus with Venice Film Festival contender "Possible Love", revisiting a divisive labour conflict that shook his home country.
item.dc:creator: Hanna Rantala
item.content:encoded: South Korean director Lee Chang-dong returned to the big screen on Sunday after an eight-year hiatus with Venice Film Festival contender "Possible Love", revisiting a divisive labour conflict that shook his home country. Lee's last film "Burning" was released in 2018 and he said the lengthy gap between films had allowed him to reflect on his responsibilities as a filmmaker. "I promised that it wouldn't take another eight years, but I was unable to keep that promise," he told Reuters. "During that time, I was able to explore, more deeply and more profoundly than ever, the fundamental questions about what cinema is and what I can do through film." VIOLENT STRIKE CRACKDOWN Inspired by real events, the film traces the consequences of mass layoffs at a major South Korean conglomerate in 2009, which sparked a prolonged strike and a violent police crackdown that left many workers traumatised. "I thought that the incident was not a problem for one company, but an incident that sent a shockwave through the South Korean society," the director said. Lee said he had originally planned to make a film directly about the dispute more than a decade ago and even completed a screenplay, but abandoned the project after questioning whether it was necessary to fictionalise the workers' experiences. "There was already a great, honest and sincere documentary out there, so I wasn't sure whether I really needed to dramatise their lives to tell their story," he said. Lee revived the project in 2024 when longtime collaborator Oh Jung-mi suggested combining the labour story with that of a fictional documentary filmmaker. The movie follows two couples, played by Jeon Do-yeon, Sul Kyung-gu, Cho Yeo-jeong and Zo In-sung, whose lives intersect during the production of a film about the laid-off workers. Jeon plays the wife of a former worker struggling with the fallout from the dispute, who carries the emotional weight of the family's ordeal. "But she's a passionate character with a very strong will, who tries to keep steering the family in a hopeful direction," the actor told Reuters. Zo, who plays the wealthy husband of the documentary maker, said the film's focus on work and human dignity resonated in an age of rapid technological change. "With the emergence of AI and the potential loss of the value of human labour, we must continue to discuss how to maintain human dignity," he said. Venice holds special significance for Lee, whose 2002 drama "Oasis" earned him the festival's Silver Lion for best director. He said he hoped audiences would once again embrace a film that asks difficult questions. "I hope the story shown in this film becomes an opportunity for more people to watch and understand the film, and to find their own answers to the questions the film raises," he said. "Possible Love", which South Korea has nominated as its entry for next year's Oscars, is one of 21 movies competing for Venice's Golden Lion.

item.title: Cardinals strive to cap wild series vs. Rockies with a win
item.description: The St. Louis Cardinals are more than halfway through their nine-game road trip, and it hasn't been boring.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The St. Louis Cardinals are more than halfway through their nine-game road trip, and it hasn't been boring. The Cardinals took two of three against the Los Angeles Dodgers, missing a sweep by one pitch, and then rallied to win 7-6 on Friday night in the opener against the Colorado Rockies. After Saturday's 10-7 loss dropped the Cardinals to 3-2 on the trip, they'll vie for a series win over the Rockies on Sunday afternoon when the teams reconvene in Denver. St. Louis' Kyle Leahy (10-4, 3.13 ERA) will match up with Colorado's Tanner Gordon (1-4, 5.18) in a battle of right-handers. Leahy, who grew up near Denver, is 2-0 with a 4.05 ERA in six appearances (one start) against his hometown team. The Cardinals (71-72) are on the fringe of the National League wild-card race. They are four games behind the Arizona Diamondbacks, who sit in the third and final spot. The most dramatic win came Friday night when Ivan Herrera hit a three-run homer in the ninth inning to turn a 6-4 deficit into a 7-6 victory, and it came after manager Oliver Marmol was ejected in the sixth. Marmol stood up for his pitcher, Hancel Rincon, who made his major league debut, after home plate umpire Doug Eddings directed the rookie to straighten his cap. "He took it upon himself to tell our rookie pitcher the kid's 'not going to wear his hat on my field that way,'" Marmol said. "You got Dontrelle Willis, CC Sabathia, Pedro Strop -- plenty of guys that have worn it way more tilted. I have an issue with that. That's just a power-hungry move, in my opinion." The Rockies (55-87) are trying to finish with a winning record on their six-game homestand. Despite having the worst record in the NL, they have generated excitement. Colorado has surpassed last season's win total (43) and holds a 17-22 record in one-run games. "I was doing some reflection and was very curious to see how many games we've lost by one or two runs -- that number is 43," outfielder Mickey Moniak said. "That's not counting the three-run, four-run, even five-run games we felt we were in. But if you look back to last year, we lost 119 games, and I'd be very curious to see how many of those were by two or fewer runs, and I would venture to say not a lot of them." There has been a slew of close games for the Rockies over the last week -- seven in a row were decided by one or two runs before Saturday night. Gordon was on the mound for the last comfortable win, a 13-1 victory at Washington on Aug. 26. He is facing St. Louis for the second time this season. He took the loss after allowing two runs in 3 1/3 innings at Busch Stadium on Aug. 9. Overall, he is 1-1 with a 1.93 ERA against the Cardinals in three appearances (one start). --Field Level Media

item.title: Six rescued after multi-storey building collapses in India's Delhi, ANI reports
item.description: Six people have been rescued after a building collapsed in the Indian capital Delhi, news agency ANI reported on Sunday, citing the police.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Six people have been rescued after a building collapsed in the Indian capital Delhi, news agency ANI reported on Sunday, citing the police. It was not immediately clear how many people were inside the premises at the time of the incident. Located in South-West Delhi, the building was being used as guest accommodation and comprised a basement along with five upper floors. According to the report, repair work was underway in the basement when the structure collapsed. "All agencies are working in coordination, with every effort focused on the safe rescue," Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta said in a post on X. Delhi Police did not immediately respond to a Reuters' request for comment.

item.title: Spencer Jones, Yankees aim for series win against his hometown Padres
item.description: The Spencer Jones homecoming tour continues to play to rave reviews in San Diego.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Spencer Jones homecoming tour continues to play to rave reviews in San Diego. The New York Yankees' rookie outfielder kick-started a four-run second inning rally Saturday with an RBI double that helped his team post a 5-1 road win. Jones and his teammates will shoot for a series win on Sunday in the finale of a six-game road trip. Jones, a product of nearby Encinitas, put New York up 2-1 in the 10th inning Friday night with an RBI single against Padres closer Mason Miller. But his hero turn was canceled when Luis Campusano blasted a game-winning two-run homer in the bottom of the inning. Nevertheless, Jones is providing quality at-bats while moving to center field on a temporary basis. The Yankees put Trent Grisham on the injured list earlier Saturday with a hamstring injury he suffered in the second inning on Friday night. "Obviously, I'm super-happy with the Yankees and being here with this organization," Jones said after Friday night's game. "But San Diego is where I grew up and my hometown, so it was really cool." Manager Aaron Boone says Jones' defense has room for improvement but is obviously comfortable enough with his skill set to play him there. "Overall, he's done a good job," Boone said. So has New York pitching in the series. It allowed only three hits in Saturday's win, improving the team's record to 81-61 and enabling it to stay within four games of Tampa Bay in the American League East. The Yankees also maintained their 3 1/2-game lead over Boston for the AL's first wild-card spot. They'll send Gerrit Cole (8-7, 3.29) to the mound on Sunday. He's coming off a 7-3 win Tuesday night at the Los Angeles Angels, which touched him for eight hits and three runs over 5 1/3 innings with a walk and five strikeouts. Cole is 5-2 with a 2.36 ERA in eight career starts against San Diego. Cole will face former teammate Michael King (9-9, 3.11), who worked six shutout innings Monday night in a 5-0 win at Cincinnati. King yielded four hits and three walks, striking out six. He's faced New York just once since it traded him to the Padres in December 2023, allowing two runs in six innings last year during a no-decision. San Diego (74-68) dropped a half-game behind Arizona, a 4-3 winner in 10 innings Saturday night at Houston, for the National League's last wild-card spot. The Padres have lost eight of their last 11 games since sweeping Minnesota two weekends ago, enabling the Diamondbacks to run them down. For right fielder Fernando Tatis Jr., it's no big secret what San Diego must do to earn its fifth playoff berth in seven years. "If we want to gain momentum, we just got to win more games," he said. Saturday's game was just another example, according to manager Craig Stammen, about how the momentum it's claimed teams get with a big win can be quashed just hours later. "The walkoff from (Friday) is already forgotten for both teams," he said. "Just a tough second inning turns the tides of that game." --Field Level Media

item.title: White Sox reset rotation, ask bullpen to pull out win vs. Twins
item.description: The Chicago White Sox know that opting for a bullpen game during a playoff hunt is less than ideal.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Chicago White Sox know that opting for a bullpen game during a playoff hunt is less than ideal. But Chicago is more focused on the next couple of weeks than the next 24 hours. The White Sox will lean on their relievers in the rubber match of a three-game series against the visiting Minnesota Twins on Sunday. White Sox right-hander Sean Burke initially was slated to start the series finale. But those plans changed after manager Will Venable and his coaching staff looked at the upcoming schedule and saw an opportunity to reset their rotation. Chicago (74-68) has an off day Monday, and the White Sox coaches decided to scratch Burke's Sunday start and give him an additional day off Monday. That means he is set to take the mound on extra rest Tuesday in the opener of a three-game home series against the Pittsburgh Pirates, and the rest of the rotation will get more rest, too. "(We) have a chance to line some things up," Venable said. "We're looking ahead and trying to get guys in the best spots. There's some implications with rest. There's some implications with matchups." Part of the reason for the change is that Burke is well past his career high in innings. In 28 games (24 starts) this season, he's at 154 2/3 innings. In 2025, he appeared in 28 games (22 starts) and threw 134 1/3. "We've seen him so good," Venable said. "(I) feel like he's getting back to form after a couple (outings) that maybe weren't as sharp as the previous stretch. Feel really good about where he's at and want to make sure that he stays there." In Burke's place, White Sox left-handed reliever Bryan Hudson (4-4, 3.03 ERA) will serve as the opener. He has 55 strikeouts in 59 1/3 innings this season spread over 61 games. Hudson is no stranger to facing the Twins. He has squared off against them in seven career relief appearances, and he is 0-0 with a 1.23 ERA in those outings. He has walked one and struck out five in 7 1/3 innings and tallied two saves. Five of those appearances against the Twins have come this season in relief. He has thrown five scoreless innings, giving up four hits and striking out three, and converted both of his save opportunities. The Twins (68-74) will counter with right-hander Bailey Ober (7-4, 4.37), who is set to make his 22nd start of the season. He is searching for his first win since July 17 against the Chicago Cubs. Ober's most recent outing came against the White Sox on Aug. 29. He drew a no-decision in a 3-2 loss after giving up two runs (one earned) on two hits in five innings. He walked two and struck out five. In 16 career starts against the White Sox, Ober is 6-2 with a 3.56 ERA. Minnesota is clinging to faint hopes of a wild-card playoff berth and also looking to get its starting rotation in order for the next few weeks. The Twins hope to welcome back ace right-hander Joe Ryan as early as Monday against the Detroit Tigers. Ryan was put on the 15-day injured list on Aug. 7 due to a left glute strain. "We know how talented (Ryan) is," catcher Ryan Jeffers said. "He's a two-time All-Star, back-to-back years. He's the ring leader of that starting pitching group. "Adding him back when every game feels like it's a super important game, if we can get a couple starts from him going down the stretch, then we like our chances there." The teams will conclude the season series on Sunday, with the White Sox leading 7-5. Chicago enters the day with a 2 1/2-game lead over the Cleveland Guardians in the American League Central division. The Twins are 3 1/2 games out of the final wild-card spot. --Field Level Media

item.title: Blue Jays push their way into wild-card spot, seek to sweep Royals
item.description: The Toronto Blue Jays are getting hot at the right time -- and taking advantage of the struggling Kansas City Royals in the process.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Toronto Blue Jays are getting hot at the right time -- and taking advantage of the struggling Kansas City Royals in the process. Aiming for a season-high fifth straight victory, the visiting Blue Jays will look to complete a three-game series sweep of the Royals on Sunday. Toronto (72-71) lost two of three to Kansas City (63-80) from Aug. 25-27, but is 7-1 since then. After winning 9-2 over the Royals on Friday, the Blue Jays got four hits from Kazuma Okamoto, including a tie-breaking RBI single in the seventh inning, for a 4-3 victory on Saturday. The Blue Jays are above .500 for the first time since 4-3 on April 3 and will enter play Sunday tied for the final American League wild-card spot. "We're a really good baseball team," infielder Ernie Clement told the Blue Jays' official website. "It was only a matter of time before things started clicking and we started playing our game." Toronto now will try to sweep its second road series of the season. They last accomplished the feat June 16-18 at Fenway Park against the Boston Red Sox. "It's nice to win," Blue Jays manager John Schneider said. "It's nice to get on a little bit of a roll. "It's nice to be in this position, for sure." Okamoto is 7-for-20 with three extra-base hits and four RBIs in his past five games. Meanwhile, teammate Nathan Lukes is 8-for-19 with four RBIs in the past four contests. Right-hander Spencer Arrighetti (7-8, 4.82 ERA) is the scheduled starter. He has made three appearances (one start) for Toronto since he was acquired from the Houston Astros at the trade deadline. Arrighetti's most recent start came Aug. 27 against the Royals, when he yielded four runs - three earned - and five hits, with two walks, over four innings of Toronto's 13-2 loss. Arrighetti yielded a two-run homer and one other hit over 3 2/3 innings as the Blue Jays' third pitcher of the game at Cleveland on Tuesday. "You need Spencer Arrighetti to go quite a bit," Schneider said. With the Blue Jays, Arrighetti has an 0-3 record with a 6.55 ERA. Kansas City stars Bobby Witt Jr., Jac Caglianone and Carter Jensen are a combined 8-for-16 against Arrighetti. Caglianone is questionable for the game. He left Saturday's game in the top of the third inning with elbow soreness. "We'll get it checked out (Sunday) morning," Royals manager Matt Quatraro said of Caglianone, the AL Player of the Month for August, when he batted .411 with six homers and 26 RBIs. Witt had three hits against the Blue Jays last week, but he's batting .194 in eight games since for Kansas City, who are 1-5 after winning 12 of the previous 13. Scheduled Royals starter Randy Dobnak (2-3, 2.65) will look to rebound after he allowed a season-high six runs and seven hits, including two homers, over six innings of a 6-3 loss to Miami on Tuesday. That performance came after the right-hander gave up a three-run homer to Lukes, and five other hits, over six innings of Kansas City's 3-0 loss at Toronto on Aug. 26. --Field Level Media

item.title: Italian Grand Prix re-started after Leclerc crashes out
item.description: The Italian Formula One Grand Prix was halted and then restarted after Ferrari's Charles Leclerc crashed heavily at Parabolica at the end of the second lap on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: The Italian Formula One Grand Prix was halted and then restarted after Ferrari's Charles Leclerc crashed heavily at Parabolica at the end of the second lap on Sunday. Ferrari reported the Monegasque was OK after a trip to the Monza medical centre. Leclerc had extracted himself from the car and sat hunched on the grass behind the barriers in the immediate aftermath. The field lined up again after a half-hour wait for the tyre wall to be rebuilt, with Mercedes' George Russell leading. Leclerc had started the race in third place with teammate Lewis Hamilton alongside in fourth but the Briton tried to pass down the inside at the first corner, with the seven-time world champion forced wide into the gravel and plunging to 11th place. "Charles pushed me off," Hamilton complained over the radio, in an incident noted by stewards, before the home race -- in front of a record crowd at Monza -- suddenly turned into even more of a nightmare. Television replays showed Leclerc, in fourth place but under pressure from McLaren's Oscar Piastri, had suffered wheelspin, touched the white line at the edge of the track and skewed off at speed at the end of lap two. The safety car was deployed and then the red flags came out on lap four. The initial restart had to be aborted when Racing Bulls' stand-in Yuki Tsunoda was out of place on the grid.

item.title: Rangers hope to stay in playoff hunt in series finale vs. Rays
item.description: The Texas Rangers are beginning to see their playoff hopes drift away.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Texas Rangers are beginning to see their playoff hopes drift away. They'll try to start reeling them back in when they host the Tampa Bay Rays in the finale of their four-game series on Sunday afternoon in Arlington, Texas. The Rangers (70-73) have lost two in a row and three of four since pulling within a half game of the final wild-card spot in the American League. Texas will head into Sunday two games back of the Cleveland Guardians and Toronto Blue Jays for the final wild-card berth and three games back of the Houston Astros atop the AL West. "We're going to do whatever we can to try and get this right because time's running out here," Rangers manager Skip Schumaker said following a 6-3, 10-inning loss to the Rays on Saturday. "We've got to start collecting some wins because we're digging ourselves a little bit of a hole right now." The Rangers identified Junior Caminero and Jonathan Aranda as players to stop heading into the series, but they've come up short the past two games. Caminero is 4-for-10 with a double, home run and three RBIs, and Aranda is 4-for-9 with two home runs and five RBIs. "Caminero and Aranda have done some damage against us and we've got to make sure they're not beating us," Schumaker said. "We've got to take a look at exactly what we're doing wrong because they've been slugging and doing damage in the wrong time of the game." Aranda has four home runs overall in the past 11 games after hitting just one in the first 34 games following the All-Star break. "The home runs will come," Aranda said through an interpreter after hitting a three-run homer in the 10th inning of Saturday's win. "I'll take them whenever they do, but I'm a contact hitter first and foremost. So, just being able to feel myself in the box, feeling comfortable and being able to put the ball in play, is the big thing." The Rays (85-57) will try to find some run support for Ian Seymour when he takes the mound on Sunday. Seymour (9-6, 4.21 ERA) has lost his past three starts, but didn't pitch poorly in any of them as the offense scored just two runs while he was in those games. He most recently allowed three runs over 6 1/3 innings in a 3-2 loss to the New York Mets on Monday, going without walking a batter for the second straight outing, and striking out 10. Seymour has faced the Rangers just once in his career. He threw 4 2/3 innings of scoreless relief on July 29 to earn the win in the 3-0 victory. He won his next two outings as well, both starts, before beginning his current winless streak. MacKenzie Gore is penciled in to start for the Rangers on Sunday. Gore (8-10, 4.31) beat the Athletics his last time out. The left-hander held them to one run and five hits in 5 1/3 innings of the 8-5 win. Gore made his only career appearance against the Rays in that July 29 matchup, going seven innings as the starter and taking the loss after allowing all three runs. He allowed first inning home runs to Yandy Diaz and Ryan Vilade. -Field Level Media

item.title: El presidente Infantino se presentará a la reelección en marzo: FIFA
item.description: El presidente de la FIFA, Gianni Infantino, sigue decidido a presentarse a la reelección a pesar de la renovada oposición a su candidatura tras un plan fallido para vender una participación en las competiciones de la FIFA a inversionistas privados, según declaró el domingo un portavoz del organismo mundial del fútbol.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente de la FIFA, Gianni Infantino, sigue decidido a presentarse a la reelección a pesar de la renovada oposición a su candidatura tras un plan fallido para vender una participación en las competiciones de la FIFA a inversionistas privados, según declaró el domingo un portavoz del organismo mundial del fútbol. Infantino, que ya había anunciado que se presentaría a un cuarto mandato en marzo del año que viene, se ha enfrentado a peticiones de dimisión por parte de la UEFA, la AFC y la CONCACAF, después de que su plan de vender una participación del 20 % en el Mundial y otros eventos de la FIFA fuera descartado en julio ante la amplia reacción negativa que suscitó. No obstante, el presidente, de 56 años, sigue contando con el apoyo de las confederaciones africana y sudamericana. "El presidente de la FIFA anunció en abril que se presentará a la reelección en 2027. Por supuesto, nada ha cambiado. El señor Infantino se presentará a la reelección", declaró un portavoz de la FIFA en un comunicado. El comunicado se publicó después de que Infantino se mantuviera hermético cuando se le preguntó si se arrepentía de las turbulentas últimas seis semanas, mientras asistía el sábado al Mundial Sub-20 en Polonia. "Habrá mucho que decir, pero habrá un lugar y un momento adecuados para hacerlo", había dicho Infantino. Nadie ha anunciado oficialmente su candidatura para disputarle el puesto a Infantino en las elecciones del año que viene.

item.title: Nepali woman found alive days after family began mourning rites
item.description: Despite the devastation of the floods, rescuers have found people who survived extraordinary conditions, including Chandika Kumari Shrestha who survived in a narrow pocket of air in her collapsed home.
item.dc:creator: Adnan Abidi
item.content:encoded: Believing she had perished in Nepal's [USN:L1N44W056 TEXT:"deadly floods"], the family of Chandika Kumari Shrestha started the ritual of mourning the elderly woman's death. Ten days later, rescuers found her alive inside her collapsed home in the devastated Betrawati village, where she had survived in a narrow pocket of air amid water and mud. "The four-storey house was swept (away) by the floods and the house was left in the middle of a quicksand. While walking around it, we heard a voice 'save me,'" police officer Mahendra Darnal said. In a rescue operation on Saturday lasting 45 minutes, Darnal and his team found Shrestha in a confined space and sent her to an army hospital. "I was in touch with the family and they had started the 11-day mourning period," Darnal said. Shrestha was among the hundreds missing in Betrawati, an area among the hardest hit by the floods in Nepal and engulfed with white deposits compacted almost like concrete. Crews continue to recover scores of dead bodies. The town's market and most residential buildings, some as tall as four storeys, were almost completely buried under debris left by a torrent that swept through the valley, part of a disaster that killed more than 1,300 people across Nepal. Thousands remain unaccounted for. Rescue workers wearing hard hats were seen digging with shovels, while some were crawling through the gaps of collapsed buildings periodically blowing whistles to get the attention of anyone trapped and alive. Five days earlier, 24 bodies were found in a decomposed state in Betrawati's market area in a building that had contained a small shop, Darnal said. LOOKING FOR SIGNS OF LIFE Eleven days since a glacial collapse triggered the devastating floods, close to 5,000 are still missing. Hundreds of bodies have been swept onto the banks of rivers far from the ravaged Rasuwa district. In Chitwan, hundreds of miles away, several rounds of [USN:L1N44R01F TEXT:"mass burials"] have taken place for unidentified and badly decomposed bodies. Even as hope is beginning to fade, Nepal authorities continue their effort to look for people stuck in tunnels and under the thick deposits of mud that have hardened over buildings. Since Friday, they have pulled out [USN:L1N44W056 TEXT:"three people from the tunnels"], including a [USN:L4N44X01J TEXT:"Chinese citizen"] by the Trishuli river, where more than 900 are believed to be trapped. Others like Shrestha have survived in extraordinary conditions, including an [USN:L4N44P0XH TEXT:"8-year-old boy"] who was also reunited with his mother.

item.title: President Infantino will seek re-election in March, FIFA says
item.description: FIFA president Gianni Infantino remains committed to standing for re-election amid renewed opposition to his candidacy after a botched plan to sell a stake in FIFA competitions to private investors, a spokesperson for the global soccer body said on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: FIFA president Gianni Infantino remains committed to standing for re-election amid renewed opposition to his candidacy after [USN:L1N43X04P TEXT:"a botched plan"] to sell a stake in FIFA competitions to private investors, a spokesperson for the global soccer body said on Sunday. Infantino, who had previously announced that he would seek a fourth term in March next year, has faced calls to resign from UEFA, the AFC and CONCACAF, after his plan to sell a 20% stake in the World Cup and other FIFA events was scrapped amid widespread backlash in July. But the 56-year-old retains support from the African and South American confederations. "The FIFA president announced in April that he will stand for re-election in 2027. Of course, nothing has changed. Mr Infantino will be standing for re-election," a FIFA spokesperson said in a statement. The statement came after Infantino [USN:L1N44X02Z TEXT:"remained tight-lipped"] when asked whether he regretted the [USN:L6N44V19H TEXT:"turbulent last six weeks"] while attending the U-20 World Cup in Poland on Saturday. "There will be a lot to say, but there will be a right place and a right time to say this," Infantino had said. No one has formally announced a candidacy to challenge Infantino in next year's election.

item.title: Poland says suspected airspace violation caused by bird flock
item.description: Authorities in Poland said on Sunday that a suspected violation of the country's airspace originating on the other side of its border with neighbouring Belarus had been caused by a large flock of birds.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Authorities in Poland said on Sunday that a suspected violation of the country's airspace originating on the other side of its border with neighbouring Belarus had been caused by a large flock of birds. The event had prompted the Polish military to scramble helicopters to verify data of a possible violation registered by radiolocation systems shortly after noon local time (1000 GMT), a spokesman for Polish Armed Forces Operational Command told Reuters. "Indications recorded by the radar systems were not related to a violation of Polish airspace. They were caused by a large flock of birds, whose passage was recorded by airspace surveillance systems," the army later wrote on X. Poland's air traffic authority PANSA wrote in a separate post on X that Rzeszow Airport in southeastern Poland had resumed operations after they were briefly suspended in order to facilitate military aviation.
